conflicts: Sharon Carter: group_timeline is The Survivors forever (-1), but our own stages say "The zombie Captain America ambushes the survivors' train and infects Sharon" and "Hope blows her apart", both in What If #5.
Kurt: The Survivors forever, but "the zombie Wanda wakes at Camp Lehigh and kills Kurt" in What If #5.

Hope van Dyne: timeline is Survivors at 71 and the Queen of the Dead's Army at 72, but she turns inside What If #5 ("Turned after her death, the giant zombie Wasp grabs the Quadjet"), so she is not a survivor for the end of 71. Her description "The Wasp, a survivor" also only fits the early part.
Okoye: Survivors at 71 until the Queen of the Dead's Army at 72, but Wanda infects her inside What If #5. Wakanda and The Survivors share 71 with no order between them.
Scott Lang: Survivors forever, but he is bitten at the start of What If #5 before Vision cures him. Minor, since he ends as a survivor.
Bucky Barnes: Survivors forever, but his last stage is Wanda hurling him away at Camp Lehigh and no later stage shows him alive. His fate is unknown, not confirmed survivor.
Vision: Independent forever, but he dies in What If #5 tearing out the Mind Stone.
T'Challa: Survivors (and Wakanda) at 71 with no end, but he dies in Marvel Zombies #3.
Kate Bishop: Survivors forever, but the zombie Captain Marvel kills her in Marvel Zombies #1.
Riri Williams: Survivors forever, but she is bitten in Marvel Zombies #1 and no stage shows her alive afterwards outside Wanda's illusion.
Yelena Belova: Survivors forever, but she dies on the Raft in #2 and "rises in Wanda's horde" for Paris.
Melina Vostokoff: Survivors forever, but Okoye kills her in #1 and she is "the zombie Melina" in Wanda's horde in Paris.
Alexei Shostakov: Survivors forever (description "a survivor"), but he "eats Wanda's tainted food and turns" in #3 and fights for Wanda in Paris.
Shang-Chi: Survivors forever, but he is bitten in the #2 flashback (held back by the rings) and Wanda's zombies infect him in Paris.
Jimmy Woo: Survivors at 72 (description "among the survivors"), but zombies kill him in New Asgard and he returns as one of Wanda's zombies in Paris.
Death Dealer: Survivors at 72 (description "among the survivors"), but he dies in New Asgard and returns as one of Wanda's zombies in Paris.
Wenwu: The Ten Rings forever, but he only appears in the #2 flashback and dies there ("dies to the zombies").
Helmut Zemo: group_timeline has The Survivors and Independent both at 72, so their order is undefined, and group_now shows The Survivors. He is killed by zombies in New Asgard in #3.
John Walker: Survivors forever, but Namor kills him in #2.
Valkyrie: Asgard forever, but Okoye kills her in Paris.
The Sorcerers of Kamar-Taj: Masters of the Mystic Arts forever, but "all three fall" in Paris.
Rocket and Groot: Guardians of the Galaxy forever, but Thanos kills them in #3.

Thor: group_timeline lists Asgard, The Avengers and The Queen of the Dead's Army twice each, all at 72, so the order means nothing. He is alive until Wanda turns him in New Asgard (#3) and is destroyed by the Hulk in Paris.

Steve Rogers: timeline says The Avengers at 71, but he is already a zombie in What If #5. It then says The Queen of the Dead's Army at 72, but no stage puts him in Wanda's horde, and Alexei destroys him in #1. Note "Bucky cuts him in half" in What If #5 is not his end, since he crawls into the North Institute in #1.
The Zombie Avengers: timeline says The Avengers at 71, but they are zombies whenever seen in What If #5. The zombie Falcon is destroyed in What If #5 and the zombie Hawkeye in Paris.
Carol Danvers: group_timeline is empty.

Thanos: grouped as The Children of Thanos forever, but no stage shows any followers; he is a lone zombie destroyed in #3. Our data also has no What If #5 stage for him, though plot: he appears at the end of that episode (high).

Okoye with Kamala (#2) says Okoye "storms the North Institute" and Yelena with Kamala (#2) says Yelena "helps defend the North Institute", while Melina's stages put Okoye's attack on the North Institute and Melina's death in #1. Either the attack spans the end of #1 and start of #2, or one set of episode numbers is wrong. Needs checking.

Zemo with Kamala is filed under #3, but most of its events (the Raft, Namor) are in #2 in our other stages; only his death in New Asgard is #3. Alexei with Kamala (#3) likewise spans #1 to #3. One stage covering several episodes makes per-episode states hard to read.

Blade Knight with Kamala says Blade "saves Kamala from Captain Marvel and Ikaris", which reads as if Ikaris is a threat, while Ikaris is described as "An Eternal fighting the zombies" and grouped with The Survivors. Needs checking.
Scott with T'Challa and Hope with Scott say "Quadjet". plot: the aircraft is a Quinjet (medium).

Many stages with no episode number belong to a known episode: the New Asgard stages (Thor with Wanda, Alexei with Wanda, Shang-Chi with Wanda, Jimmy Woo, Death Dealer) match the #3 New Asgard stages, and the Paris stages probably belong to #4. Without numbers the app cannot time the group changes.
Riri with Kamala (no number) says "Riri breaks into the illusion"; that is inside Wanda's illusion and should not be read as Riri being alive in Paris.
Descriptions freeze an early state: Hope "a survivor", Okoye "among the survivors", Alexei "a survivor", Jimmy Woo and Death Dealer "among the survivors", Kurt and Sharon "a survivor".
